a.speaker: Sunday, September 12
a.text:
By Sunday the smoke has thinned to a brown edge on the horizon. {partner.name} spreads the hospital's surge-drill checklist on the kitchen table: one kit and one plan for every hazard, the way the state's 2 Weeks Ready asks.

The family adopts the Bedrock as its first shared goal: Water, Pantry, Warmth, Medicine, Circle, Plan and Skills. The fridge card will name one gap each week.

From here, each week has three blocks: Weeknights, Saturday and Sunday. Orders ship two Mondays out. October 17 is the Last Truck.
